provenance.note: One corn cycle a year, 2016-2023, from the site record first (cal-val-data, US-Bi2__management_field) and the monitoring product's planting and harvest v5.0 days where the record gives none. The monitoring product's 2019 G6 cycle (planted 2019-02-05, harvested 2019-05-22) is dropped: the field is continuous corn and was flooded and anoxic until mid March 2019. UAN at 118 kg N/ha once a year at planting (Anthony and Silver 2021) replaces the fertilization product's rows. The 2019 and 2020 planting and fertilization days are read from Anthony and Silver 2021 Fig. 2; the 2019 harvest is the recorded 2019-09-11. Harvests use the shared lookup's hay row for silage, an assumption for David. No tillage: the monitoring product's tillage is not used. Water, as decided on 2026-07-16: the irrigation product's 2021 and 2022 events, and the record's dated winter floods (delta-flooding-0009, 0012, 0013, 0014) held by 69 mm every 7 d as soil irrigation. The spud ditch sub-irrigation (delta-irrigation-0004 to 0007) is subsurface water left to the water table and the run's flood configuration, which this file does not set. See tools/event_prep/README.md.

events.provenance_note: UAN once a year at planting (delta-fertilization-0014), on the planting day. 118 kg N/ha, the rate Anthony and Silver 2021 give for 2017-2020 (delta-fertilization-0013), carried to 2016. The N is written as nh4_n_kg_m2; SIPNET adds NH4 and NO3 into one mineral N pool. The fertilization product's rows for this parcel are not used.
